content:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx + high tail latency observed for Hosted API and Dedicated pools in eu-west-2. Metric: 5xx_rate > 2% for 3 consecutive mins. Alert ID: INC-4627.
maya: seeing spike in token-exchange latencies in logs, lots of timeouts to upstream credential service in eu-west-2.
joel: confirm — curl to our cred-proxy shows 504s from the region: `curl -v https://cred-proxy.eu-west-2.internal/health` -> stalled.
sam: routing table shows retries/backoff hitting multiple hosts. Dedicated pools pinned to eu-west-2 are returning `503` on auth failure paths.
maya: customer impact — some EU customers report generation timeouts and intermittent 5xx. CS report from @cs-tilly: "several enterprise customers saw failures for 2-3 mins, degraded latency for others."
ops-lead: immediate steps: (1) fail open token refresh for non-sensitive endpoints (cache tokens) (2) divert new auth requests out of eu-west-2 to eu-west-1/eu-central-1 where feasible (3) increase Dedicated capacity in fallback regions.
joel: starting reroute rule now. Patch for proxy fallback: `service.auth.reroute.region = eu-west-1` applied to routing layer.
infra-bot: autoscale signal sent to eu-west-1 dedicated pool: +20% capacity.
maya: rolling config to bypass non-critical KMS calls for logging to reduce egress.
sam: adding a short-lived cache window for token expiry checks: 30s to reduce immediate refresh storm. Deploying lambda that serves cached tokens for retries.
joeL: (typo) sorry — joel: captured traces: majority of 503s are originating from downstream credential handshake failing after 3s. Opening support case with AWS on regional credential service (case 12345678).
cs-tilly: flagged to customers in impacted orgs, no major SLA breaches expected but we told them we're rerouting and will follow up.
maya: monitoring: error rate trending down after reroute; 5xx back to ~0.3% in the last minute. Latency tail still elevated for some calls (95p).
ops-lead: handoff to night oncall in 30m — @joel you staying for handoff?
joel: I can stay 20m then hand to @sam. Leaving runbook notes: `INC-4627 mitigation steps` in ops-runbooks channel.
sam: taking handoff at 4627780200. Next actions: keep AWS case open, watch for token refresh spike when cache window expires, plan for gradual rollback of reroute once STS/cred service healthy.
incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> customer-impact reduced. Resume monitoring for 2h. Incident ticket: INC-4627.
maya: thanks all. :thumbsup:
